title: SMOK Arco Replacement Pods - 2ml
description: Smok Arco Replacement Pods are designed for use with the Smok Arco Digi Pod Vape Kit , offering a mess-free, flavour-rich experience with no coil swaps required. Each pod is pre-fitted with a mesh coil and features a secure side-fill system and leak-resistant construction for reliable daily use. Choose from four resistances to match your preferred vaping style: • 0.4ohm: Loose RDL draw with rich vapour output (25W optimal). Best with High-VG or low-nicotine 50/50 e-liquids. • 0.6ohm: Versatile RDL or open MTL draw (21W optimal). Ideal for 50/50 freebase or 10mg Nic Salts. • 0.8ohm: Tighter MTL draw with pronounced flavour (16W optimal). Best with Nic Salts or 50/50 e-liquid . • 1.1ohm: Smooth, tight MTL draw with discreet vapour and satisfying nicotine delivery (10W optimal). Best with higher-strength Nic Salts. The built-in coil design means no coil changes—simply refill and replace the pod when needed. All pods are TPD-compliant with a 2ml e-liquid capacity. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
